description: This file contains the implementation of a Flutter page for listing notes with associated ViewModel. It includes state management, user interface, and user interaction logic for viewing, searching, deleting, and navigating notes.

classes.name: NotesListViewModel
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based ViewModel that manages state for the notes list, including loading notes, updating query, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesListPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the notes listing page with search, refresh, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads all notes from repository based on current query.

methods.name: updateQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and reloads notes.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID and reloads the list.

methods.name: _NotesListPageState.build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the notes list page, reflecting the current state.

methods.name: _NotesListPageState._confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog before deleting a note.
